ei.lesson: The study of emotions and decision making is now o

fullPassage: The study of emotions and decision making is now of considerable importance. This involves the application of various tools afforded by neuroscience. One important stream of the literature examines people with brain damage and how damage to particular parts of the brain known to be responsible for particular cognitive functions impacts on decision making. One example of this research is the work of Antonio Damasio, who finds that when the emotional part of the brain is damaged, this actually reduces the efficacy of decision making. Good decisions are a product of the emotional part of the brain working in conjunction with the deliberative part. This contradicts the assumptions of conventional economics, where emotions play a negative role in the decision-making process. Here it is assumed that decision making can be modeled as being generated in a stoic, unemotional fashion, and that is why decisions tend to be optimal. But the evidence suggests that emotions actually play an important and, often, a positive role in decision making.

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'This contradicts the assumptions of conventional economics'가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 감정+숙고 결합이 좋은 결정을 만든다는 발견이 전통 경제학(감정=부정적)의 가정과 충돌
det.analysis:
① 감정 도움 vs 무감정 가정 충돌 → 핵심 의미 ← 정답
② 방법론 혁신 → 방법론 아닌 가정의 충돌
③ 수학적 모형 무효화 → 모형이 아닌 가정 반박
④ 경제학 공부 필요 → 오히려 가정이 잘못됨
det.tip: This = 감정+숙고 결합의 긍정적 역할. contradicts = 전통 경제학의 감정 부정론과 충돌.

ch: 감정이 의사결정에 도움이 된다는 발견이 전통 경제학의 무감정적 의사결정 가정과 상충한다.
신경과학 연구가 전통 경제학의 방법론에 혁신을 가져왔다.
뇌 손상 연구가 경제학의 수학적 모형을 무효화했다.
좋은 의사결정을 위해서는 전통 경제학을 공부해야 한다.

questions.passage: The study of emotions and decision making is now of considerable importance. This involves the application of various tools afforded by neuroscience. One important stream of the literature examines people with brain damage and how damage to particular parts of the brain known to be responsible for particular cognitive functions impacts on decision making. One example of this research is the work of Antonio Damasio, who finds that when the emotional part of the brain is damaged, this actually reduces the efficacy of decision making. Good decisions are a product of the emotional part of the brain working in conjunction with the deliberative part. This contradicts the assumptions of conventional economics, where emotions play a negative role in the decision-making process. Here it is assumed that decision making can be modeled as being generated in a stoic, unemotional fashion, and <u>that is why</u> decisions tend to be optimal. But the evidence suggests that emotions actually play an important and, often, a positive role in decision making.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>that</u>가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'that is why decisions tend to be optimal'에서 that = 앞의 '무감정한 방식으로 모형화된다는 가정'
det.analysis:
① 무감정 가정 → 'decision making can be modeled as stoic, unemotional' = that의 지시 대상 ← 정답
② 감정 부정적 사실 → 사실이 아닌 가정
③ 뇌 손상 발견 → 다른 맥락
④ 감정+숙고 결합 → 반대 주장
det.tip: that is why = 그것이 ~한 이유이다. that = 앞 문맥의 가정.

ch: 뇌 손상이 인지 기능에 영향을 미친다는 발견
